'''Phaedacomm''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]-managed high-security [[Space station/Legends|space station]] at the edge of the [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]]. The station handled signal traffic for [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] and kept the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] connected to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was also equipped with [[Medcenter/Legends|Med Station]] with a quarantine area, and was protected by a [[Mine/Legends|mine field]]. The seizure of Phaedacomm cut off all communications of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine was later [[Raid on Dantooine|targeted]] by the Mandalorians.

In [[3962 BBY]] the station was [[Skirmish on Phaedacomm|taken over]] by [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] under the command of [[Dorjander Kace]].
